title: Widower's Nest: Pot Luck I
description: Widower's Nest: Pot Luck I — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect Hatchling Eggs from the Fire Fade Hatchling Leader in the dungeon off of Level 3 of the Widower's Nest and 25 Whisker Points from the Poison Whiskers throughout upper Widower's Nest and Return to Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk in Level 1 of the Widower's Nest.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk

Repeatable: No

Zone: The Widower's Nest

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect Hatchling Eggs from the Fire Fade Hatchling Leader in the dungeon off of Level 3 of the Widower's Nest and 25 Whisker Points from the Poison Whiskers throughout upper Widower's Nest and Return to Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk in Level 1 of the Widower's Nest.

Offer:

The Townston Commander told you about our predicament, right? We got so caught up in testing the 'new' dungeon that the Pot Luck completely slipped our minds.

First things first, we need appetizers. I was thinking something light and mildly nauseating. We don't want to start out too strong, now do we? I would be personally disappointed if people started hurling after the first course.

Ok, one of the ingredients I will need is some Hatchling Eggs. We need some high no, make that really high quality stuff. So, see if you can get them from the Hatchling leader in the dungeon off of level 3. In there you should find an expecting Hatchling to get the eggs from.

Once you get the eggs the next ingredient you will need is some crispy Whisker Points. Those you can find on the Poison Whiskers here in the Widower's Nest. The Whisker Points are the ears from the Whiskers and some of their ears are crispier than others. You will have to kill a lot of Whiskers to get enough of the quality we are looking for.

Once you have all of the ingredients you need return to me, Soldier Clohz of Yorbahk, here in Level 1 of the Widower's Nest.

Turn-in:

Don't tell me you got everything? That is fantastic! With your help the Pot Luck just might be the best Pot Luck ever, although the likelihood of someone keeling over is still pretty high... Anyway, here is your reward and we will call on you again soon.

Objectives:

  • Hatchling Eggs ×1
  • Whisker Points ×25

Level range: 20–40
